meta.note: Labeled benchmark subset for sybilkit's regression gate (PRD §3.5, §8). Joined from docs/curator_sybil_data/{cluster_economics,suspects,same_amount_clusters,index_runs,funding,tx_fingerprints}.json plus the deposit rows from deposits.json.gz and the join indices from first_deposits.json.gz.  Self-contained: sufficient to run detect() end-to-end offline.
meta.labels: `cluster` names one of the 16 audited operators for a member and is null for a control.  `funding.funder_in_cluster` is true when the funder is a member of that address's OWN cluster (full membership, not just the sampled ten); for a control it is true when the funder belongs to ANY audited cluster; and it is null when the funder could not be resolved -- null is not false.
